mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students ( id, name, faculty, batch, created_by, created_on ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{faculty}, #{batch}, #{createdBy}, #{createdOn} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, faculty, batch, created_by, created_on, updated_by, updated_on, deleted_by, deleted_on FROM students WHERE deleted_on IS NULL ORDER BY id

SELECT id, name, faculty, batch, created_by, created_on, updated_by, updated_on, deleted_by, deleted_on FROM students WHERE deleted_on IS NULL AND ( CAST(id AS TEXT) = #{value} OR LOWER(name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{value}), '%') OR LOWER(faculty) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{value}), '%') OR LOWER(batch) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{value}), '%') ) ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET name = #{studentName}, faculty = #{faculty}, batch = #{batch}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_on = #{updatedOn} WHERE id = #{studentId} AND deleted_on IS NULL
